title: MIT App Inventor Tutorial for Beginners: Build Your First Android App
summary: App Inventor Tutorial for beginners: learn how to build your first Android app step by step using drag-and-drop blocks, with no coding experience required.
body_markdown: Create a step counter app that tracks movement and lets users save step counts as separate records. This project introduces real-time sensor-based thinking, simple data saving, and debugging ideas like using lists for multiple saved entries and avoiding duplicate procedure names.
